column1: # TrendForce's figures for China's AI chip market, as the trade site Silicon UK reported them in June 2026 (idea 14; read by build.py).
# A different measure from IDC's counts in share.tsv: not one series with them, and drawn in a panel of its own.
#   year    2025 = TrendForce's figure for "last year" | 2026 = expected (a forecast made in June 2026)
#   who     foreign = Nvidia, AMD and other foreign suppliers, together | makers = Chinese makers of AI chips | own = chips tech firms develop mainly for their own use
#   share   per cent, as the report gives it; build.py reads both years' figures from the words of the quotes.tsv line named in qkey and stops if they differ
